name: Russia–Ukraine
value: 33 killed at aid site; 289 drones 3 Nov
summary: Toll from Russian strike on Zaporizhzhia aid point reaches 33; mass drone and missile strikes
state: The toll from the 2 Nov Russian guided-bomb strike on people collecting aid in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region, rose to 33 on 3 Nov, with dozens missing (Ukrainska Pravda). Overnight into 3 Nov Russia launched 289 drones and 17 ballistic missiles at energy sites and a Kharkiv medical facility, Zelensky said (Euronews). US-mediated working-level talks are planned for 10–11 Nov in Abu Dhabi.
for_you: Follow FCDO advice against all travel to Ukraine. Energy-market effects are indirect.
